chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a huge mitten. It was so big it could fit many hands! One day, a small child stepped up to the big mitten, and held it in their two hands. They pulled and tugged, but the mitten would not yield. The child got bigger and bigger, but still the mitten wouldn't move.

So, the child decided to try something else. They called out to their friends, and soon they all surrounded the mitten, each one grabbing a hold of it. Together, they managed to make the huge mitten yield. They pulled and pulled, and the mitten finally moved! Everyone cheered in joy.

The child and their friends took the huge mitten to the playroom and used it in lots of fun games! The mitten was a magical toy that taught the children teamwork, patience, and the importance of working together.
Every day, the mitten yielded to the children’s will, bringing them hours of fun and joy.

chapters.title: Once there was a boy named…
p: Once there was a boy named Tom. Tom was a very fair boy who liked to play outside. One day he was playing near a pond, blowing bubbles with his bubble wand. He loved to watch the bubbles drift up into the sky.

But suddenly, one of the bubbles broke! Tom was so sad and wanted to repair the bubble. He searched around until he found a glue stick, then worked hard to glue the pieces of the broken bubble back together.

Once he was done, Tom blew the repaired bubble and watched it float away. He was so happy and proud of himself. Tom had used his fair skills to repair the bubble and it worked perfectly! And from then on, he enjoyed playing with bubbles in a very fair way.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a humble triangle. She wanted to count all the stars in the sky. She looked up and tried to count one, two, three…but the stars were too high up and she couldn’t reach them.

Suddenly the triangle saw a star twinkle. With a big smile, she went to say hello. But when she reached it, she discovered the star was a friendly bird! They said hello and the bird offered to help the triangle count the stars.

The bird flew up nice and high. With her long beak, she counted one, two, three stars. Then she flew down, and the triangle counted four, five, six stars. Then the bird flew up, and they counted seven, eight, nine stars! All the way, they kept counting until the triangle had reached the last star.

The triangle thanked the bird for giving her the chance to count all the stars. She had never been so happy before, and they both said goodbye with a big hug. From that day on, the humble triangle always remembered to look up and count the stars.

chapters.title: Once there was a loyal fish…
p: Once there was a loyal fish who swam in the sea. One day, the fish went looking for something to eat. It stirred the water with its fin, searching for something good. Suddenly, the fish found something! It was a big and tasty insect. The fish quickly snapped it up and ate it. The happy fish continued to stir the water until it found something else to eat. After a while, it was full and swam off back to the ocean. It was a loyal fish and was happy in the end.

chapters.title: Once upon a time a girl…
p: Once upon a time a girl named Lisa set off on an adventure. She wanted to find some healthy news.
So Lisa went to the park. She saw many people having fun and playing games. Everyone was smiling and having a nice time.
Lisa went to the pond and saw a lot of ducks. One of the ducks was carrying a news paper in its beak! Lisa was very excited. She asked the duck to give the news paper to her.

The duck kindly accepted the request and Lisa started reading the news paper. She saw a lot of healthy news about people eating healthy and exercising. Lisa was very happy. She thanked the duck and went home with a big smile on her face.
From then on Lisa made sure to live a healthy life and to keep reading the news. She shared her healthy news with her family and friends. Everyone in the town was very happy and healthy.

chapters.title: Once there was a seal swimming…
p: Once there was a seal swimming in the sea. He was a strong seal, and he loved to swim. He swam around and looked for food in the blue water.
Suddenly, he noticed a small boat. He watched it for a minute, and then he kept swimming. He kept exploring the deep ocean.
But then, he noticed something strange in the water. It was a big yellow fish! The seal was curious, so he swam closer to check it out. He was strong, and the fish didn't scare him.

Finally, the seal noticed something even stranger. It was another seal! He was surprised, but happy to see a friend. They swam together and played in the sea. They were happy and strong, and they had a great time.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there lived…
p: Once upon a time, there lived a little girl named Liza. Liza loved playing in the forest with her friends. One day, she noticed that the forest was not as organized as it was before. The trees had fallen down, and the paths were all mixed up.
So Liza decided to sort it out. She worked all day, moving the trees and clearing the paths. When she was finished, the forest was organized again.
But then Liza saw a scary wolf. She froze and was too scared to move. But the wolf was very friendly and started to help Liza with her work. The wolf moved the trees for her and cleared the paths.

Together, Liza and the wolf sorted the forest out. When they were finished, the forest was very organized. Liza and the wolf were happy that they had worked together. They lived happily ever after in the organized forest.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a generous temple. People liked to spend time there to be peaceful.
One day a little 3-year-old girl went to the temple. She was very excited. She asked her mommy and daddy if she could stay and play.
They said yes, so she ran around the temple, looking at all the pretty flowers and a softly-flowing river. She even saw animals from far away and a big tree with so many birds in it.
After a while she decided to spend some time with her mom and dad. They were all very happy to have had a special day together.
The generous temple was happy too and gave them a special gift of love to take home.
The little girl thanked the temple and promised to come back soon to visit.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a boy with blue eyes and blonde hair. He was so excited that he couldn't stop bouncing. He wanted to go to the pond and splash in the warm sunshine.
So the boy ran over to the pond and giggle as he jumped in. The water was so cool and he had so much fun. He made big splashes that reached all the way up to the sky.
Soon, the boy was getting tired, but he couldn't stop. The sun was getting impatient and starting to set. He wanted to keep playing, but his mom said it was time to go home.
So the boy got out of the pond and waved goodbye. Then he ran home, looking forward to having more fun tomorrow.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved to collect things. He would go around his house every day looking for something special to keep.
One day, he found a very special place. It was a very serious place with lots of things to collect. He spent lots of time there searching for treasures.
He found a shiny rock, feathers, and many other things. He put them all in a bag and took them home. He was so happy with all the things he collected.

The little boy kept collecting from the serious place. He added so many things to his bag that it became heavy to carry. He would go back over and over again, always finding something new to take home.
He eventually made so many trips to the serious place that all his special things filled up his room.
The end.

chapters.title: Bob was a guard He had…
p: Bob was a guard. He had a wide hat and a big stick. He always watched the gates. One day Bob saw something and he felt sad. He wished he could have done something, but it was too late.
Bob didn't know what he had seen. But he felt like he had done something wrong. He was so sad he started to cry. He regretted what he had done.

Then one day, Bob saw something very special. It was a beautiful butterfly. Bob felt so happy that he stopped crying. He wanted to be a friend and guard the butterfly. So every day, Bob watched the butterfly and kept it safe.
Every day, Bob forgot about his regret and felt more and more happy. He was so happy to be a guard and look after the butterfly. This was all he wanted to do any more.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a family with two kids. One day, when they were outside, it started to rain hard. The rain came down really fast and soon the ground was all wet. The kids said to their parents, "Look, it's a flood!"

The water was coming up higher and higher and it started to come into the house. The parents were worried and said, "Come on, let's go upstairs so we can be safe." Upstairs, the family watched as the flood water kept coming in. The water was so high that it was touching the roof.
The kids were getting scared and started to cry. Their mom said, "It's okay, sweeties. Everything will be alright." But soon the water kept getting higher and the family had to go outside.

The flood was so strong that it hurt the family. They had to hold onto each other to stay safe. Finally, the flood stopped and the family was safe. The family was so happy to be safe and said, "We made it!"

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a bunny. He was a very funny bunny! He liked to hop around the garden, looking for carrots and playing with the other animals.

One day, he hopped all the way to the river. The river was so big and blue that it made the bunny stop and stare. He was about to hop down to the water's edge to have a drink, when he spotted something else. In the river was a pot of ink. It was cold, just like the river.
The bunny hopped closer to take a look, and noticed that the ink was a very special shade of blue. He thought it must be special ink, and he wanted it for himself.

So he hopped closer still, and tried to reach in and grab it. But it was too slippery and cold, and he could not catch it. But with five hops, he splashed the ink pot, spilling it on the ground. The ink spread out, turning the bunny's fur a beautiful blue.
And ever since, the bunny has always hopped around with a blue tinge - a reminder of that special ink.

chapters.title: Once there was a little girl…
p: Once there was a little girl named Jenny. She was three years old and loved going to the park. One day, Jenny went to the park with her parents. She saw a big fountain in the middle of the garden. Jenny wanted to explore it. She quickly ran to the fountain. Suddenly, she saw a rude puppy in the fountain! The puppy was barky and tried to bite her when she came close. So Jenny snapped her fingers and the puppy flew far away without hurting her.

Jenny was very happy she was brave enough to snap her fingers and send the puppy away. She looked at the fountain and saw lots of colourful fish swimming in it. Jenny asked her parents if she could touch the fish and they said yes. She put her hand in the water and the fish started swimming around it. It was so fun!

From that day, whenever Jenny wanted to have some fun, she would go for a visit to the fountain at the park. She would snap her fingers and play with the fish. She was so happy and thankful she was brave enough to snap her fingers and send the puppy away.

chapters.title: Once upon a time in a…
p: Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a tall man. The tall man had a big dog. They were best friends. They liked to play together in the park.

One day, the tall man lost his red ball in the park. He was sad. He asked his big dog to find the red ball. The big dog nodded his head and went to look for the red ball. He ran and sniffed all around the park.

Finally, the big dog found the red ball near a tree. The tall man was very happy. He gave the big dog a reward for finding the red ball. The reward was a big bone. The big dog wagged his tail and ate the bone. They played with the red ball together and went back to their small house. They were happy.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a witch. She lived in a big, open house. The house was in the middle of the woods. The witch was nice and liked to help people.
One day, a little girl named Lily got lost in the woods. She saw the witch's house and went inside. The witch saw Lily and wanted to help her. She gave Lily some food and a warm place to sit.
The witch reminded Lily to always stay close to her home. She told Lily that the woods can be scary. Lily thanked the witch and went back home. From that day on, Lily never got lost again.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot. Spot liked to play outside on the ground. He loved to run and jump all day long.
One day, Spot saw a big hole in the ground. He started to worry. He thought it was a very serious problem. He did not want anyone to fall in the hole.

Spot ran to his friend, a little girl named Sally. He barked loudly to tell her about the hole. Sally saw the hole and understood that it was serious. She put a big rock by the hole so no one would fall in. Spot was happy and stopped worrying. They played together and had lots of fun.

chapters.title: Once upon a time in a…
p: Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a lot of fog. The fog was so thick, that the people could not see far. They had to be very careful when they walked or played outside. The sun was weak and could not shine through the fog.

In this town, there was a little girl named Lily. She wanted to reach the top of the big hill, where she heard there was a beautiful garden. But the fog made it hard for her to find her way. She asked her friends to help her reach the top.

Together, they walked slowly and held hands. They took turns being the leader, so no one would get lost. After a long time, they reached the top of the hill. The fog was still there, but they could see the beautiful garden. They played and laughed, and had a great day. And when it was time to go home, they walked down the hill together, happy that they had reached the top.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to eat her food with sauce. One day, she felt uncomfortable because her favorite sauce was all gone. She was very sad.

Lily's mommy saw that she was unhappy. So, she went to the store and bought more sauce for Lily. When Lily saw the sauce, she felt so much better. She was very happy and excited to eat her food with the sauce again.

Lily said, "Thank you, mommy, for getting me more sauce!" Her mommy smiled and gave her a big hug. They both enjoyed their meal with the yummy sauce. From that day on, Lily always remembered to thank her mommy for the things she did for her.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved to draw with her pen. One day, Sue was careless and her pen fell on the floor.
Sue looked for her pen, but she could not find it. She was sad because she wanted to draw a big sun and a happy tree. Sue asked her mom to help her look for the pen.

Mom and Sue looked everywhere. They looked under the bed, behind the chair, and in the toy box. At last, they found the pen under the table. Sue was so happy! She hugged her mom and said thank you. Then, she drew the big sun and the happy tree with her pen. Sue learned to be more careful with her things.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a big red jeep. It had four big wheels and a loud horn. The jeep believed it was the best car in the town. All the other cars were envious of how cool the jeep looked.

One sunny day, the jeep saw a small blue car. The blue car was sad because it did not look as cool as the jeep. The jeep wanted to help the blue car feel better. The jeep had an idea and told the blue car to wait for a surprise.

The next day, the jeep came back with a big red bow for the blue car. The blue car was so happy and now looked very cool. All the other cars were envious of the blue car too. The jeep and the blue car became best friends and drove around the town together, sharing their coolness with everyone.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a red wagon. The red wagon lived in a big yard with a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play with the red wagon every day. She would put her toys in the wagon and pull it around the yard.

One sunny day, Lily was playing with the red wagon when she noticed a little cat. The cat was hiding under a tree. Lily wanted to be friends with the cat, so she was very careful not to scare it away. She slowly walked over to the cat with the red wagon.

Lily put some food in the red wagon and pulled it to the cat. The cat saw the food and came out from under the tree. The cat ate the food and then jumped into the red wagon. Lily and the cat played together all day, and they became the best of friends.

chapters.title: Once there was a small bug…
p: Once, there was a small bug. It was an unusual bug. It could change its size. One day, it was playing near a tree.
The bug saw a big ant. The ant was sad. It could not get food from the tree. The bug wanted to help the ant. So, it changed its size. It became one inch long.
Now, the bug and the ant could get the food. They were happy. They played and ate together. The unusual bug and the ant became good friends.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a horse named Dull. Dull lived in a stable. He was not very happy because he had a bad leg. Dull's leg made him suffer a lot.
One day, a girl named Sue came to see Dull. She said, "Hi, Dull! Why are you sad?" Dull told her about his bad leg. Sue wanted to help Dull feel better.

Sue brought Dull a soft blanket to put on his leg. She said, "This will help your leg feel better, Dull." Dull felt happy that Sue cared about him. Soon, Dull's leg did not hurt as much. Dull and Sue became good friends and played every day.

chapters.title: Once upon a time in a…
p: Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a boy named Tim. Tim was a happy boy who loved to play with his friends. He liked to learn new things but sometimes he was ignorant about the truth.
One day, Tim's mom told him that he would receive a gift from his grandma. Tim was very excited and could not wait for his gift. He told all his friends about the gift and they were happy for him.

When the gift came, Tim opened it and found a book. The book taught him about the truth of the world and how to be kind to others. Tim learned many things from the book and was no longer ignorant. He shared the truth with his friends and they all became better people. And they all lived happily ever after.
